question: Dipika Pallikal is a __________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Squash Player**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dipika Pallikal is an Indian professional squash player: **
 
• She was the first Indian woman to break into the top 10 of the Professional Squash Association (PSA) world rankings in 2012. 
 
• She is **one of the most decorated Indian squash players of all time**, with 11 professional titles and international medals. 
 
• In 2012,
 
 
• **she became the first Indian women's squash player to win the Arjuna Award. **
 
 
 
• In 2014, **she was awarded the Padma Shri.** 
 
• In 2023, **she won a gold medal in the Mixed Doubles Final at the Asian Games with her partner Harinderpal Singh. **
 
• Pallikal was born in Chennai into a Malayali family. She took a break from squash in 2018 to start a family and pursue other interests, including interior design.
 
• She returned to the sport after four years.
